scenes.title: The Last Thread of Winter
scenes.narration: Rin was the tailor who made a new coat for the keeper of each season. On the final evening of winter, she waited in her hilltop workshop with a nearly finished green coat for spring. Sev, the winter keeper, should have arrived before sunset to return his silver spool. Without that last thread, the coat's lining could not be closed. When the door finally opened, Sev held the spool tightly. "Please leave the coat unfinished. I am not ready to let winter go."

scenes.title: What the Spool Remembered
scenes.narration: Sev explained that winter vanished from his mind whenever he gave up its final thread. He would remember his duties, but not the quiet pleasure of snow falling against a window. "This spool holds the last of that feeling." Rin had always believed that the keepers welcomed each new season without regret. Now she understood why he had arrived late. She set her needle down and offered him a chair. Finishing the coat mattered, but rushing him would not make the parting easier.

scenes.title: A Memory to Carry
scenes.narration: Rin examined the spool. There was enough thread to close the spring coat, with a little left over for Sev's own blue cloak. She knew two ways to keep a memory inside a garment. A hidden pocket could hold one real snowflake, unchanged until the pocket was opened again. A woven design could preserve the sound of snowfall, though it would contain no snow. Either would let Sev finish his work and remember what he loved. Rin explained both possibilities and let him choose.

scenes.title: A Place for One Snowflake
scenes.narration: Sev chose the pocket. Rin stitched it inside his blue cloak and held it open near the window. One snowflake drifted in and remained bright against the cloth. She used the rest of the thread to finish the green spring coat. Outside, the first buds appeared on bare branches. Sev fastened his cloak, feeling the tiny pocket against his chest. Winter no longer filled the room, but its memory could travel with him. "Now I can rest until winter returns." He stepped outside.

scenes.title: The Sound in the Lining
scenes.narration: Sev chose the woven design. Rin used the extra thread to stitch a silver spiral inside his blue cloak. When he brushed it with his fingers, he heard snow settling softly on a windowsill. There was no ice against his skin, only the remembered sound. Rin finished the spring coat with the remaining thread. Outside, the first buds appeared. Sev closed his eyes once, then opened the door without hesitation. "I can welcome what comes next without pretending that winter meant nothing."
